data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 14.6m (2016: favourable development of GBP 17.8m); this comprises releases of GBP 15.4m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business, releases of GBP 0.8m in respect of total Reinsurance business, and strengthening of GBP 1.6m across other classes.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a small net favourable prior-year reserve development overall. The gross claims development triangle analysis indicates a small net release of approximately GBP 3.1m (around 0.6% of opening gross claims reserves). Management also reports net favourable prior year development of GBP 14.6m net of reinsurance, driven largely by releases in Direct Third Party Liability business (reported release GBP 15.4m), small releases in Reinsurance acceptances (GBP 0.8m) partially offset by strengthening across other classes (GBP 1.6m).

data.data_quality_notes: The Movement in prior year's provision note reports a NET (after reinsurance) favourable development (GBP 14.6m) but does not present a single GROSS aggregate movement. Accordingly the gross prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development (triangle) as a fallback, producing an estimated gross net release of ~GBP 3.14m. The reported net and triangle-derived gross figures differ (net GBP 14.6m vs gross ~GBP -3.14m) because the note's headline figure is net of reinsurance recoveries and because the note breaks movements down by class net of reinsurance. Users should note this discrepancy; gross PYD here is derived from the gross development table.
